about.title: The guilt-free food hub
body: Healthy Lab (مطعم المعمل الصحي) is a healthy restaurant in Al Ghubra Ash Shamaliyyah, Muscat. The menu runs to 90 dishes and drinks, from exotic salads, lean burgers and coconut-flour pizza to rice buckets, protein shakes and guilt-free sweets.
Almost every dish lists its calories, protein, fat and carbohydrates, and the protein and carb sources are sold by weight, so you can build a meal to your own numbers.

faq.q: Do you list calories and macros?
faq.a: Yes. Almost every dish on the menu shows its calories, protein, fat and carbohydrates, as written by our kitchen. Open any dish to see them.
Online by debit or credit card through Thawani Pay, cash on delivery, or cash or card at the counter when you collect.

faq.q: Why do some dishes say the price depends on options?
faq.a: Those dishes, such as the lean burgers, buckets, juices and coffee, are priced by the options you choose. Ask us and we confirm the price before you order.
Choose a goal, the size of the plan and the dishes you like. We call you to agree the menu, delivery days and price. The estimate on the page uses today's menu prices.
In Al Ghubra Ash Shamaliyyah, Muscat. Open the branch page for the map and directions.
